definition_en: a person who marries another while still legally married to someone else
core_image: 同一人揣着两本结婚证，两场婚礼隔着城市
scene: 两份婚姻档案送进法庭，法官皱起了眉。The bigamist was arrested soon after the second wedding.
sceneCN: 这里 bigamist 是「重婚者」（第 1 个义项：在婚期间又与他人结婚之人）；句意是重婚者在第二场婚礼后不久被捕。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「重婚（罪）」，bigamist 由其派生
bigamy 加形容词后缀，义为「重婚的」
同族反义概念，义为「一夫一妻制」

senses.title: One married to two spouses at once
senses.definition: someone who enters a second marriage while the first remains legally valid
senses.definitionCN: 在第一段婚姻仍具法律效力时再缔结婚姻之人
senses.example: The bigamist was arrested soon after the second wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 重婚者在第二场婚礼后不久被捕。
senses.why: Greek bi- means twice and gamos means marriage, so the person has married twice.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 bi- 意为「两次」，gamos 意为「婚姻」，故指结了两次婚的人。

senses.title: One who deceives both spouses
senses.definition: someone concealing an existing marriage from a new partner
senses.definitionCN: 向新伴侣隐瞒已有婚姻之人
senses.example: The bigamist kept two households in different cities.
senses.exampleCN: 重婚者在两个城市各养一个家。
senses.why: Bigamy requires deception, and the deceiver is the bigamist.
senses.whyCN: 重婚必涉欺瞒，行欺瞒者即重婚者。

senses.title: One prosecuted under bigamy law
senses.definition: a defendant charged with the crime of bigamy
senses.example: The court convicted the bigamist of fraud as well.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭同时判该重婚者欺诈罪成立。
senses.why: Naming the person follows the name of the crime.
senses.whyCN: 罪名既立，犯者随之得名。

senses.title: One whose second marriage is void
senses.definition: someone whose later marriage is legally invalid because of the first
senses.definitionCN: 因已有婚姻而使其后缔结的婚姻无效之人
senses.example: As a bigamist, his second ceremony carried no legal weight.
senses.exampleCN: 身为重婚者，他的第二场婚礼毫无法律效力。
senses.why: Law voids the overlap, branding its maker a bigamist.
senses.whyCN: 法律宣告重叠婚姻无效，其缔造者遂成重婚者。

senses.title: Serial or accidental bigamist
senses.titleCN: 惯犯或无心之失的重婚者
senses.definition: a person who commits bigamy repeatedly or through forgotten earlier marriages
senses.definitionCN: 屡次重婚，或因遗忘旧婚而再婚之人
senses.example: The wanderer became a bigamist without remembering his desert marriage.
senses.exampleCN: 流浪者忘了荒漠里那场婚，成了无心重婚者。
senses.why: Intent matters less than the legal fact of two marriages.
senses.whyCN: 比起意图，两段婚姻的法律事实更为关键。

senses.title: In literature, the deceiver figure
senses.definition: a stock character of fiction who keeps parallel married lives
senses.definitionCN: 小说中维持双重婚姻生活的定型人物
senses.example: The novel's bigamist falls when the two letters cross.
senses.exampleCN: 小说里的重婚者因两封信交错寄达而败露。
senses.why: Double lives make the bigamist a dramatic engine.
senses.whyCN: 双重生活使重婚者成为戏剧引擎。

senses.title: Compared with polygamist
senses.definition: one with two overlapping marriages, as distinct from one with many sanctioned spouses
senses.definitionCN: 重叠两次婚姻者，区别于获准多配偶者
senses.example: Unlike a polygamist in a permitted system, the bigamist breaks the law.
senses.exampleCN: 与允许多配偶制度下的多配偶者不同，重婚者触犯法律。
senses.why: Two hidden marriages differ from many open ones.
senses.whyCN: 隐秘的两次婚姻，不同于公开的多偶。

senses.title: One whose bigamy dissolves status
senses.definition: a spouse whose offense ends recognized marital standing
senses.definitionCN: 因重婚罪而失去认可婚姻地位者
senses.example: The bigamist lost custody in the divorce that followed.
senses.exampleCN: 重婚者在随后的离婚官司中失去监护权。
senses.why: The crime dissolves the very status it pretended to keep.
senses.whyCN: 罪行摧毁了它所伪装维系的身份。

intro.en: Bigamist is bigamy, twice-married, plus the agent suffix.
intro.cn: bigamist 由 bigamy「重婚」加施动者后缀构成。

items.en: bi- (from Latin) plus gamos, marriage, gave digamos, twice married.
items.cn: bi-（经拉丁语）加希腊语 gamos「婚姻」，得 digamos「结过两次婚的」。

items.en: bigamus meant twice married; bigamia, the condition.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bigamus 意为「再婚者」；bigamia 指再婚状态。

items.en: in canon law bigamia narrowed to unlawful second marriage.
items.cn: 在教会法中 bigamia 收窄为非法的第二次婚姻。

items.en: English bigamy took the criminal sense; bigamist names the offender.
items.cn: 英语 bigamy 确立刑事义；bigamist 指犯罪者。

items.en: now a legal and everyday label for one married twice at once.
items.cn: 如今是法律与日常对同时两婚者的称谓。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the gam- marriage root; the near-meaning group gathers marriage-law terms.
note.cn: 形近组共享 gam-「婚姻」词根；近义组汇集婚姻法律类词。

entries.definition: the crime of marrying while already married
one who is unfaithful to a spouse

entries.definitionCN: 偏执者——拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: one married to a single spouse
entries.definitionCN: 一夫一妻者——同根 mono-（单一）

normalIntro.en: Bigamist is bi- (two) plus gamos (marriage) plus -ist.
normalIntro.cn: bigamist 是 bi-（二）加 gamos（婚姻）加 -ist（人）。

normal.en: Bigamy is the crime; bigamist is the person.
normal.cn: bigamy 是罪名，bigamist 是犯者。
第二次婚姻在法律上无效。

normal.en: Polygamist holds several, not just two.
Gamos also gives monogamy and polygamy.
normal.cn: gamos 还构成 monogamy 与 polygamy。

abstract.en: See two wedding rings on one hand.
abstract.cn: 看一只手上戴两枚婚戒。

abstract.en: Feel the double life collapsing at one knock on the door.
abstract.cn: 感受一声敲门让双重生活崩塌。

abstract.en: Picture two wedding albums on the same shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象同一书架上并排的两本婚礼相册。

examples.en: The bigamist was arrested soon after the second wedding.
examples.cn: 重婚者在第二场婚礼后不久被捕。

examples.en: The bigamist kept two households in different cities.
examples.cn: 重婚者在两个城市各养一个家。

examples.en: The court convicted the bigamist of fraud as well.
examples.cn: 法庭同时判该重婚者欺诈罪成立。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必·盖」——婚事必有一层盖一层，两本红本子叠着藏，是为重婚。

root: 拉丁语 bi-「二」加希腊语 gamos「婚姻」经拉丁语 bigamus「再婚者」复合；教会法将 bigamia 收窄为非法再婚，英语承其刑事义，bigamist 以施动者后缀 -ist 指称犯者。

sensesIntro.en: From twice-married grows the deceiver, the defendant, the void bridegroom, and the fictional double-lifer.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「两度结婚」长出欺瞒者、被告、二婚无效者与文学中的双重生活者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two rings, one finger, two lives
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚手指两枚戒，一体两命

branches.en: The overlapping marriages and their nullity

intro.en: Bigamist stacks a number prefix, a Greek marriage root, and an agent suffix.
intro.cn: bigamist 由数词前缀、希腊婚姻词根与施动者后缀叠成。

latinIntro.en: The gamos family through Greek and Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 gamos 词族及其拉丁与英语后裔。
